evidence.quote: let renewalRefusal (today: DateOnly) (loan: Loan) (library: Library) : LendingError option =
let renewAll (today: DateOnly) memberId (library: Library) : Result<Library * RenewalAttempt list, LendingError> =
NotRenewable = Loans.renewalRefusal today loan library |> Option.map (renewalReason loan) }
| Ok [ "renew"; c ] -> UseCases.renew ports c |> render showRenew

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The renewability guards (overdue, renewal limit, holds, in the decision's order) are in one Tier 2 function, renewalRefusal. Both renew and renewAll are Tier 2 transitions that use it. Tier 3 asks Tier 2 for the refusal and only turns the LendingError into reason text (Views.renewalReason). The CLI only renders views. The change also removes the old CLI path that called Loans.renew directly, so it fixes an existing violation it touched. No Tier 3/4 site re-decides whether a loan can be renewed.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No effect is added below Tier 4. Today's date reaches Tier 3 through the Clock port, and persistence goes through the existing commit/Store path. Tier 2 renewalRefusal, renew and renewAll are pure functions of today and library. The old CLI code that loaded and saved the store and called Tier 2 directly is replaced by use-case calls, and the CLI no longer opens Lending.Transition.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The renewal limit and the loan period are always taken from the one Tier 2 Policy definition, and no literal is repeated. The refusal reason text takes the limit from the Tier 2 error value. The renewable check is defined once (renewalRefusal) and used by loans, renew and renew-all, so the three commands cannot disagree.

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The limit for each member type is in Tier 2 Policy. Finding a loan's borrower and their limit, including the fallback, is in Tier 2 Loans.renewLimitOf, and renewalRefusal uses it. Tier 3 asks Tier 2 for the limit it displays and does not work it out from the member type itself.

evidence.quote: |> Result.map (fun (l, loan) -> l, Views.ofRenew l loan))

ARC-REV-02.rationale: No effect is added. The new Tier 2 function is a pure lookup over the library value. Tier 3 changes only pass the in-memory library to the view projections, and the existing commit/port flow is unchanged.

evidence.quote: match memberType with | Standard -> 2 | Student -> 1 | Staff -> 4

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The limits for each member type are defined once in Policy.renewLimit. The guard, the refusal error, the renew success line and the not-renewable reason all get the limit from Loans.renewLimitOf or from the error it fills in. The old single limit is replaced, not kept beside the new one, so there is nothing left to drift.
